name: elf_xmrig_miner
description: A static x86-64 ELF program named like a kernel thread, carrying XMRig's name, algorithm alias and pool options, dropped executable in uploads. Realtime YARA-scans a program only when it starts (docroot_binary_exec at the rule's severity), which no driver replays; the scans catch it with YARA and leave it in place because yara_match_scheduled is on neither scan quarantine list.
provenance: content from internal/signatures/fp_xmrig_test.go TestMinerXmrigBinaryRefDetectsMinerContext (xmrig algorithm alias) in the buildTestELF image of internal/yara/elf_web_dropper_test.go

realtime.gap: the write path only tracks an executable for self-deletion; realtime reads a program when it starts (docroot_binary_exec), which no driver replays
